peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 12.8% below its local comparables; 6 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (14.7): 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 7 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 58.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,974,000 ($2,032 psf, 947–1,011 sq ft; 8 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,241 psf (range $1,973–2,732); 9.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $203,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,850,000 ($1,933 psf, 1,474 sq ft; 7 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,309 psf (range $2,035–2,991); 16.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $554,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Redhill MRT about 160 m, Queenstown MRT about 1,250 m; closer than 39 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Gan Eng Seng Primary School about 620 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 470 m), more than 21 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Redhill Market about 380 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 680 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,080 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,460 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,660 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,710 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,800 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,850 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,850 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 150 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,715 new sales and 837 resales (2,552 purchases); new sales were 67.2% of these purchases. Subsales (8) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 837 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 40 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 837 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,016 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.6%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
